bio.text: Phillip Pettus represents House District 1 (Lauderdale County) in the Alabama House of Representatives, to which he was elected on November 4, 2014.
According to the legislature's profile, he graduated from Rogers High School and attended Shelby State Community College and the University of North Alabama.
He served as an Alabama State Trooper, reaching the rank of captain, and retired in 2013 after 25 years of service.
